paragraphs: This site compiles official tasks, statistics, and regulatory material, and the K1—K5 exercises, ability stages, and transition distances are FermatMind editorial design, not an employer exam or a personality admission standard.

O*NET39-5094; BLS2025 salaried wages and the 2025—2035 independent projection; the basis for publishing China's 2022 occupational standard, the NHC medical aesthetics measures, health commission explanations, NBS2025 background, and the Guangdong 2023 survey; the California rules and the Marriott sample each retain their scope.

This round on 2026-10-02 checked the O*NET national five percentiles, the 18 tasks and occupational interests, the BLS independent projection and four-industry hourly wages, the NBS2025 tables, the two Guangdong 2023 beautician wage rows, the California conditions and FAQ, the Marriott public text, and the Weihai health commission explanation. The NHC original page failed to load, so the measures were verified via a health commission republication; for the 2022 occupational standard only the official contents were verified, not the full application conditions. ILO, LLM, and NIST methodology follow the material already verified in this batch.

This page explains the US occupation in Chinese and compares related Chinese positions and does not establish qualification mutual recognition. The paper exercises use fictional data and do not perform skin procedures or provide medical tutorials. Real service requires confirmation per local training, qualifications, institutional scope, and employer processes.
